newsitem.title: USA: Assets of money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Assets of the nation's 650 retail money market mutual funds rose $8.97 billion to $611.91 billion this week, an industry group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of 395 taxable money market funds rose $5.98 billion to $498.08 billion, while assets of 255 tax-exempt funds grew $2.99 billion to $113.84 billion.

The trade group said assets of the 317 institutional money market funds rose $5.93 billion to $302.01 billion. Of these, the 254 taxable money market fund assets increased $3.67 billion to $270.26 billion, and assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds grew $2.26 billion to $31.76 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $913.93 billion in the week. Assets for last week were revised to $899.03 billion from $894.84 billion.
